While the Crazy_top reference image emphasized leaf proliferation and stunting, the disease affects overall plant development. The twisted stalk in the test image could represent abnormal structural development caused by the Crazy_top disease agent affecting vascular/cellular development, resulting in the characteristic gnarling and tan/brown discoloration (necrotic/diseased tissue).

The tan/brown coloration and the pattern of multiple affected stalks with twisted deformation is consistent with a systemic developmental disorder rather than a localized stalk rot.
